resolution_notes: Verifier B is correct on all three disputed fields. Official docs (rate-limits page) define method-specific hard limits: 2/s for search/named/random/collection, 10/min for manifest, 10/s elsewhere, with 429 then 30s limited access—not a blanket ~10 req/s. free_tier_limits should reflect data/image guidelines (Magic software, research, community; no paywalling or bare repackaging) rather than “commercial requires prior written permission.” CORS is documented as yes for GET/HEAD/POST/OPTIONS when Origin is sent (http-concerns). All other fields left null (keep original).
free_tier_limits: Free under Scryfall data/image guidelines (Magic software, research, community content); no paywalling or bare repackaging; commercial use not simply “requires written permission” as originally stated
rate_limits: Hard limits: /cards/search, /named, /random, /collection = 2/s; /cards/manifest = 10/min; other methods = 10/s; 429 then ~30s limited access
